response.overview: Kayo, Sakurako’s aunt who had left her without a word, has returned to Ginza. Amidst all this, Sakurako finds herself strangely drawn to Takasugi, a man who suddenly appears.
response.tagline: The third instalment in the hugely popular series—a live-action adaptation of Ryo Kurashina’s original work—depicting a woman living in the world of the night.
response.title: ネオン蝶 第三幕
